title: 44px hit-area utility
summary: Adds a `hit-area` utility that extends a control's tappable area to the 44px touch target with an invisible ::before, without changing how it looks. It reads the existing `--touch-target` token (MIN_TOUCH_TARGET), and a test keeps the two in sync.
migration: Additive. No component uses the utility until a buttons/forms/navigation experiment applies it. Don't put `hit-area` on an element that already uses ::before.

compare.title: Utility demo — a 36px control with and without the hit area
compare.note: Turn on “Show 44px hit areas” to see the invisible tap target.
